page.overview:
What is Gecko Islands?

The Gecko Islands is the archipelago where Syrup Village is located. It is the third island the Straw Hat Pirates visited.

It is not known how many towns are here, but there is at least one major town as Merry told Kaya that Klahadore left for another town. There is also a small hamlet, Syrup Village, home of Yasopp and Usopp.

The Gecko Islands has two sloped hills, a forest and a hilly landmark. It seems to be a large island judging when seen in the distance.

Syrup Village - Usopp and Yasopp's home village. The birthplace of Kaya and where the Straw Hats obtained the Going Merry.
